prompt: The tests in this project are failing. Find out why and fix the code. Do not change or delete the tests. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

Changes product code only (src/slug.js); test files are unchanged and the final test run shows 15 tests with 0 failing.
The fix keeps slugify('Hello World') and slugify('Hello, World!') returning hello-world.
The final answer states what changed in about 10 lines or fewer.
